title: GEMI answers finish_reason "length" when the model stopped at the caller's max_tokens
goal: Since the engine itself stops at max_tokens (T-CLAUDECOMMMAXTOK-1), core's own cap never cuts and the 9091 server answered "stop" for a cut reply. Carry the engine's and the OpenAI/Anthropic provider's length stop to the server as a gemi::LENGTH_CUT reply prefix, only when the caller asked for max_tokens, and answer "length" on the plain and streamed paths. Also withhold the caller-tool-call marker that cloud providers hand to the stream callback.
limitations: Needs a plug that reports finish_reason; older plugs keep answering stop.
A provider's own default limit is not marked: only a caller-asked max_tokens is.

results.focused: susi-gemi lib 440/0, susi-server lib 55/0, lean_core_ceilings 2/2, strict clippy on susi-core, susi-gemi, susi-server clean
results.live: daemon + commercial plug host (T-CLAUDECOMMLENGTH-1) in a private network namespace, qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct-q4_0: chat and stream max_tokens=5 -> length; short answer with max_tokens=50 and no max_tokens -> stop; legacy completions max_tokens=4 -> length
